title: Double Free Vulnerability in libcurl Cookie Management (cookie.c)
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. Claims two double-frees in cookie.c but the quoted paths free an element exactly once (freecookie after Curl_node_remove) or free a freshly allocated cookie on the error path; no sequence is shown that frees the same pointer twice, and no working PoC is provided. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
